newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Wednesday edition:
WASHINGTON - Teamster Union officials said Giant Food Inc. shoppers will see picketers outside several dozen of the company's 174 grocery stores as a strike by delivery drivers enters its fourth day.
WASHINGTON - With the economy on a moderate growth path and inflation low, Federal Reserve officials made no change in key short-term interest rates when they met in a policymaking session.
WASHINGTON - A U.S. District judge ordered Conrail Inc. to move ahead with a key shareholder vote on its merger plans with CSX Corp.

WASHINGTON - Northern Virginia high technology executives asked state legislators to enact broad new technology education programs to include mandatory computer training for college students and grade school teachers.
